name: MORPH OBSERVATORY v1
notes: Weight x Muscle is treated as coupled semantics for observation, not independent physiological variables.
Proportions is observed separately as shoulder-to-hip balance.
Firmness/Cupsize are kept in the female breast-shape domain.
Raw per-vertex deltas are aggregated and not persisted in JSON.
Pair nonadditivity is measured in ANSUR24, limb profiles, vector-correct SOMA joint deltas, regional mean displacement and mesh volume.
MORF pauses atomically before another LAB can take over the shape state.
